# AIFLOXIUM

> AIFLOXIUM is an Agentic Systems and AI implementation studio run by Muhammad Shadab Shams. The site focuses on agentic systems, Agentic OS architectures, custom vibe coding platforms, applying AI to existing systems and databases, autonomous agents, and product-grade implementation support.
